posts.title: Back in Cambridge - this time for media testing / media release 20261121
posts.description: I never did quite finish the blog posts for mini-DebConf Cambridge at ARM - sorry, but life got in the way. Videos are now available in the Debian video archives. Back in Cambridge for release of Debian 13.8 - testing is going well. posts.title: Arm Cambridge - Mini-Debconf Cambridge - day 1 20261107
posts.description: Half way through the day: A morning of technical talks: Vock - Instrumenting, kernel coverage and process tracing Rebuilding the archive on your desktop An overview of Secure Boot An excellent lunch - with thanks to Liv and her Arm catering staff Three lightning talks - two without slides :) Excellent day so far :)

posts.title: Arm Cambridge - pre mini-Debconf days 20261105
posts.description: At Arm in Cambridge for two hackathon-type days before the main mini-Debconf on Saturday and Sunday. A roomful of people, mostly very quiet this morning but with people gradually arriving and greeting each other. Just had an excellent lunch. Arm are excelling themselves, as ever.
